newsitem.title: ITALY: Pope announces conference to promote family values.
newsitem.headline: Pope announces conference to promote family values.

text.p: Pope John Paul said on Sunday the Roman Catholic Church was preparing an international rally in Brazil next year to promote family values.
The Pope told pilgrims at his residence south of Rome that the second rally for families would be held in Rio de Janeiro on October 4 and 5.
"It will great party for families from Latin America and from the whole world," Pope John Paul said in his weekly Angelus message. The first such rally was held in Rome in October 1994.
The Pontiff has made the "defence of the family" from the dangers he says are posed by modern society, including divorce, abortion and cohabitation outside marriage, one of the themes of his papacy.
The Pope announced earlier in December that he would travel to Rio de Janeiro in October 1997.
The trip could provide an opportunity for the 76-year-old Pontiff to visit communist Cuba following an invitation from President Fidel Castro during an historic audience at the Vatican last month.
